title.zh: FCA Targets Three More London Sites Over Unregistered P2P Crypto Trading
title.en: FCA Targets Three More London Sites Over Unregistered P2P Crypto Trading

current_state.zh: The FCA, HMRC, and Metropolitan Police raided three London premises on September 10 and issued cease and desist letters to suspected unregistered peer-to-peer crypto trading businesses, following an earlier April sweep whose evidence now supports criminal investigations.
current_state.en: The FCA, HMRC, and Metropolitan Police raided three London premises on September 10 and issued cease and desist letters to suspected unregistered peer-to-peer crypto trading businesses, following an earlier April sweep whose evidence now supports criminal investigations.
